# Product scope

Make each contributor's actual work visible in a public near-live portfolio with many independent ways to be recognized.

## Audiences and recognition

- Visitors discovering people and current work
- Contributors showing evidence across roles
- Newcomers finding ways to help
- Maintainers recognizing stewardship and checking accuracy
- Community displays and livestream viewers

- Observed activity with raw counts
- Qualified/accepted outcomes under published rules
- Reviewed optional recognition receipts
- Editorial spotlights labeled as selection

The default time window is the last 30 days. Support 7, 30 and 90 days, all-time, custom UTC half-open windows and calendar presets. Define event time separately from ingestion and acceptance time. Use dense ranks (1, 2, 2, 3), stable ordering within ties and comparable source coverage for movement. A user-account actor is not evidence that work was manual.

## Ways to discover contributions

- Entire organization
- Repository
- Project
- T0-T6 or mapped program workstream
- Contribution category
- Role
- User accounts/automation/all
- Date window
- First observed qualifying contribution with history caveat

Discover every attributable contributor through the searchable directory, including people whose observed work does not qualify for a ranking. Show evidence-backed portfolios rather than only podiums. Research, triage, review, accessibility and maintenance must be as discoverable as code. No inactivity lists, employment evaluation, compensation decisions or pressure-inducing streaks are part of this product.

## Public journeys

1. A visitor selects a contribution category, period and source scope, then opens a contributor's evidence.
2. A contributor shares a portfolio with contribution roles, source links, accepted outcomes and coverage caveats.
3. A newcomer finds a way to help through source issues and their existing owners.
4. A maintainer reviews an attributed action, investigates the original artifact and issues a correction with a receipt.
5. A community display shows new work with a visible freshness state, pause controls and a quiet fallback if collection stops.

## Integration boundaries

These are intended boundaries for the leaderboard. Statements about the existing source applications describe the recorded organization audit; publishing this plan does not provision a leaderboard server.

**New repo:** Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-leaderboard

**New project:** Contributor Leaderboard Delivery; see docs/PUBLICATION.json

**Public entry:** Proposed contributors.pickyour.ai plus links from organization profile and website

**Research boundary:** Research repository supplies public evidence and ownership; its frozen builder contracts remain unchanged. Leaderboard contracts are a separate bounded schema.

**Website boundary:** Current React/Vite website is static on cPanel; retain it as an independently deployed frontend. The proposed leaderboard server requires separately approved infrastructure.

**Mobile boundary:** Android/Apple Projects are consumers and contribution scopes. Their 258 Backlog planning items are not shipped applications. No duplicate mobile backend is introduced.

**Unboarded work:** Include eligible repository activity even without Project membership; .github#2 and website#31/#32/#33 demonstrate why boards alone are incomplete.

**Existing authority:** Live GitHub Assignees and native relationships remain authoritative. Do not transfer ownership or reparent existing issues to the new program.

Repository membership must be versioned by stable IDs. Existing imported history can be shown under an explicitly separate inherited-history lens. Unknown organization-adoption dates stay unknown. Project membership is a lens, not an eligibility requirement: unboarded PRs, issues and organization-guidance work remain visible when eligible.

The [release manifest](../planning/release-manifest.json) separates mandatory foundations, the first complete user journey and conditional modules. Hosting, source installation and runtime delivery stay open until their own evidence gates pass.
